content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Pubity's PostPubityMarch 16 at 5:20 AM · Shared with Public"Marty Supreme" ended the 2026 Oscars with zero wins, despite going into the night with nine nominations including Best Picture and Best Actor for Timothée Chalamet.
